title: What is Durrah Al Munawwara Transport?
content: Durrah Al Munawwara Transport (شركة درة المنورة للنقل) is a Saudi transportation and logistics company established in 2014. It specializes in large-scale passenger transit, Hajj & Umrah shuttles, international bus routes, and worker transfers.

title: What are your business hours?
content: Our customer support team is available Saturday through Thursday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Saudi time (AST). For urgent Hajj/Umrah operations during peak seasons, dispatch runs extended hours.

title: Do you offer airport transfers?
content: Yes. We provide private and group airport transfers across major Saudi cities. Sedan airport transfers typically start from competitive rates based on distance and vehicle class — request a quote in the app or chat for an exact price.

title: How do I request a human agent?
content: Say that you want to speak with a human, or ask for an agent, and our system will escalate your chat to the live support inbox.
